evolution_theme: A frosty beaver trio: 1. Fluffernib (Flying Ice) - a small, fluffy beaver with icicle-tipped tails; 2. Glaciwatt (Flying Ice) - a robust, winged beaver with a shimmering, ice armor and flying capabilities; 3. Borealord (Flying Ice) - a majestic, regal beaver with massive ice wings and a frosty crown, commanding blizzards.
